run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T06:05:38Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is explained by a rollout of the ad and payment deployments at 2026-11-15T06:04:04Z. Both deployments were replaced by new ReplicaSets (same 2.1.3 image names) and their old pods were deleted at 06:04:07-06:04:08. Neither deployment defines a readiness, startup or liveness probe, so the new pods were reported Ready and put behind their Services while the applications were still initialising; both containers were heavily CPU-throttled (ad ~89-94%, payment ~93-99% of CFS periods) against CPU limits of only 50m and 20m. The ad application only logged 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 06:10:25 and payment only 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 06:05:17. During those gaps frontend calls to the ad ClusterIP 100.65.180.246:8080 and checkout calls to the payment ClusterIP 100.70.188.60:8080 were refused (gRPC code 14 UNAVAILABLE, connect ECONNREFUSED). Frontend's own error spans on GET /api/data / grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (387 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans over the 76m window, peak ~260 per 5m) and on POST /api/checkout / grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (42.7 error spans) returned HTTP 500, which drove the alert at 06:05:38. Errors stopped around 06:12-06:16 and the ad pod is now serving requests again.

claims.text: In the 76-minute window ending 06:21:57Z, frontend recorded 387.15 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on span_name 'GET /api/data', 387.15 on span 'GET', 387.15 on client span 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', and 42.68 each on 'POST /api/checkout', 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout'.

Frontend error spans carry the exact downstream diagnostic: the 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' client span has otel.status_code ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code 14 and grpc.error_message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080', and its parents 'GET /api/data', 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and 'GET' carry http.status_code 500.

Service 'ad' in namespace otel-demo is ClusterIP 100.65.180.246 on port 8080 with selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad, which is exactly the address refused in the frontend GetAds error; service 'payment' is ClusterIP 100.70.188.60 on port 8080, the address refused in the checkout Charge error.

The frontend 'GET /api/data' error count first becomes non-zero in the 1-minute evaluation point at 06:05:00 (window 06:04:00-06:05:00) and returns to 0 from the 06:12:30 point onward; the 5-minute view shows its first non-zero value at the 06:05:38 evaluation point and zeros again from 06:16:38.

Pods ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 and payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 both started at 2026-11-15T06:04:04Z, while every other otel-demo pod started at 05:30:19-05:32:01Z; all pods currently report phase Running, ready true, restart count 0.

Events show the pre-existing pods were removed and replaced at 06:04:04-06:04:08: 'Stopping container ad' and 'Deleted pod: ad-554b849958-mbnxm' at 06:04:07, 'Created pod: ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6' and 'Started container ad' at 06:04:04/06:04:06; the same SuccessfulDelete/SuccessfulCreate/Started sequence exists for payment (payment-55766d76b9-c4wgb deleted 06:04:08, payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 started 06:04:07).

ReplicaSet ownership confirms a controller-driven rollout: ad-6cb57f76d (owner deployment 'ad', created 06:04:04Z, ready 1) replaced ad-554b849958 (owner 'ad', replicas 0); payment-9c8ffb665 replaced payment-55766d76b9. The new ReplicaSets use image 'ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad' and '...:2.1.3-payment'.

The new ad pod ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 is Running since 06:04:04Z with container started 06:04:06Z, Ready=True from 06:04:07Z, restartCount 0 and no previous container instance, yet its own logs show 'Ad service starting.' only at 06:08:31Z and 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' only at 06:10:25Z.

The ad deployment's container spec defines no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe and limits CPU to 50m (request 10m); the payment deployment likewise defines no probes and limits CPU to 20m (request 10m).

Both new containers were severely CPU-throttled during startup: the CFS throttled-periods ratio for ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 was 0.89-0.94 from 06:04:30 to about 06:11, and for payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 was 0.93-0.997 from 06:04:30 to about 06:06:30.

Ad's own server-side spans show the traffic gap while nothing was listening: span 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' counts were 96, 110 and 74 at the 06:03:00, 06:04:00 and 06:05:00 evaluation points, 0 at every returned point from 06:06:00 through 06:13:00, and 144 at 06:14:00; ad logs then show normal 'Targeted ad request received for [...]' entries from 06:12:43 onward.

Payment's own log shows 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 06:05:17Z, and its own error metric series (GET, dns.lookup, tcp.connect) are 0; the payment failures were seen on checkout's client spans, 34.83 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' and 34.83 on 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder'.

Checkout traces show oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge failing with gRPC code 14 and status description 'connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused"', propagating as code 13 on PlaceOrder and as frontend 'POST /api/checkout' and 'GET/POST' spans with http.status_code 500; the frontend checkout error counts were non-zero only in the 06:04:00-06:07:00 range (18 at the 06:05:00 point, 62 at 06:06:00, 4 at 06:07:00).

Other otel-demo services did not record errors on the paths frontend uses for these requests: in the 76m window the only other error series were small flagd client errors (ad flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 1.02, fraud-detection EventStream 3.05, recommendation /flagd...EventStream 4.06, cart EventStream 0), and no error series were returned for email, shipping, currency or product-catalog.

Primary cause: the 06:04:04Z replacement of the ad pod removed the only serving ad instance, and because the ad Deployment has no readiness/startup probe the new pod was reported Ready and treated as a live endpoint while its JVM was still initialising under a 50m CPU limit (89-94% CFS throttling). Traffic to the ad ClusterIP 100.65.180.246:8080 was therefore refused until the server listened at 06:10:25, making frontend GET /api/data return HTTP 500 and driving the RequestErrorRate alert at 06:05:38.

Secondary contributor to the same frontend alert: the simultaneous replacement of the payment pod produced a shorter unavailability gap (container started 06:04:06, server listening 06:05:17) with the same missing-probe and 20m CPU-limit pattern (93-99% CFS throttling), so checkout calls to payment were refused and frontend POST /api/checkout returned 500 for roughly 06:04:30-06:06:30, adding about 43 frontend error spans to the error rate.

What the 06:04:04Z rollout changed is not determinable from the available evidence: the new and old ad/payment ReplicaSets carry the same image reference (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad and ...:2.1.3-payment), so this may be a config-only template change, but the deleted pods' image digests can no longer be read and the change_history integration is not available.

A crash, OOM or back-off of the ad application is not supported: the ad container has restartCount 0, no previous terminated container instance, and the only ad/payment events in the window are Killing/SuccessfulDelete/Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started/SuccessfulCreate - there is no OOMKilled, Evicted, Unhealthy, Failed or BackOff event.

A node-wide or all-service outage is not supported: all 21 otel-demo pods are Running and ready with 0 restarts, and 19 of them (including frontend, cart, checkout, product-catalog) have been up since 05:30:19-05:32:01Z; the only pods replaced at 06:04:04Z are ad and payment, and the refused addresses are precisely those two Services' ClusterIPs.

Rejected: ad application-level failure caused by its flagd dependency. Ad recorded only one flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream error span (1.02) and 0 ResolveBoolean errors in the window, whereas the frontend's GetAds failures are TCP/dial failures (connect ECONNREFUSED) and ad server spans are absent entirely during the gap, so flagd evaluation errors do not explain the frontend errors.

gaps: change_history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so the actor and content of the ad/payment deployment change at 2026-11-15T06:04:04Z (and why both rolled out together) could not be verified.

The alerting rule RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (status no_data), so the alert expression, its ratio definition and threshold, and the 'current: 2.5777777777777775' value in the alert payload could not be verified from Prometheus.

The frontend container produced no readable log lines for 06:00:00-06:16:00Z (fetch_pod_logs returned no_data with 0 lines read), so frontend application-log corroboration of the 500s is missing; the conclusion rests on its spans.

Old pods ad-554b849958-mbnxm and payment-55766d76b9-c4wgb no longer exist, so their image digests cannot be compared with the new pods to confirm whether the 06:04:04 rollout changed the image or only configuration.

Exact onset/cessation times are bounded by the metric evaluation buckets (onset inside 06:04:00-06:05:00, last non-zero 1m point 06:12:15); no per-request timing was read, and trace span counts are not request counts.
next_steps: Add gRPC/TCP readiness and startup probes on port 8080 to the ad and payment deployments so a pod is not added to the Service endpoint set before its server listens.
Raise the ad container CPU limit above 50m (and payment above 20m) or add a startup CPU allowance, then verify startup time and throttling during a test rollout.

Review the deployment/change audit trail for the 2026-11-15T06:04:04Z ad and payment rollouts (including serialized rolling updates across both services) to identify what triggered the simultaneous pod replacement.

Re-check the RequestErrorRate alert expression and its current state after 06:12:15Z to confirm the alert resolves now that ad and payment are serving; if ad is redeployed with the current spec, the same frontend 500 burst should be expected.
